Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.3: Print Awareness

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Print Awareness, part of READING in PP2 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: What pictures and out of school. in reading picture stories to each interest learners?
